name: Chocolate Cake
description: Rich Belgian chocolate layered between soft, moist sponge and finished with a silky ganache glaze. Every slice delivers deep cocoa intensity balanced with just the right amount of sweetness—perfect for birthdays, celebrations, or late-night cravings.
additionalInfo: Allergy Information: Contains wheat, eggs, milk.
Ingredients: Flour, brown sugar, cocoa powder, butter, eggs, milk, chocolate, rising agents, flavouring, icing sugar.
Our products are made in an environment where nuts, gluten, peanuts, sesame, and other allergen ingredients are used.
Our cakes are handmade to order; hence, the finished product may slightly differ from the images.
